Grab a brobot and get ready to make Haven City twice as loud.

Cross-platform 2-player co-op arrives in Roboquest VR on July 23, letting Guardians team up with friends across supported platforms. Find a partner through Quickplay, connect with a Room Code, or invite a friend directly before heading into the full campaign together.

Build separate loadouts, share weapons, revive fallen teammates, and fight through mechanical swarms side by side. Chests and rewards are generated individually, while shared objectives keep both Guardians moving through each run as a team.

Roboquest VR is a fast-paced roguelite FPS fully rebuilt for virtual reality, featuring more than 70 weapons, manual reloading, physical gunplay, high-speed movement, distinct Guardian classes, procedurally generated runs, and persistent Basecamp upgrades.

Cross-platform co-op will be available as a free update for Roboquest VR on PlayStation VR2 on July 23.

After crash landing on a mysterious ringworld known as Halo, the Master Chief is tasked with defending humanity against an overwhelming alien force: the Covenant. Sniper Dan is Coming to PS5 on 17 September 2026 (Digital & Physical)

Meet Dan. Dan has a sniper rifle. Don’t panic. He’s not here to harm anyone 😉

Dan’s a professional and his job is fixing things. From a distance. With pinpoint accuracy and very good intentions.

Sniper Dan is a family friendly 3D hidden object game with a ridiculous twist. Instead of clicking on objects, you line up a carefully judged shot and fix the problem in the most unnecessarily precise way possible.

Every job is a small mystery. Spot what’s wrong, read the clues, scope the scene and take the shot. No enemies. No violence. Just everyday problems being politely corrected with long range accuracy.

Explore colourful locations packed with visual jokes, secret jobs and silly situations. Take on special challenges, earn rewards, upgrade your rifle and decorate your office hub as you grow your entirely legitimate problem fixing business.

It’s cosy. It’s comedic. I
